description: Pharmacokinetic and Cytochrome P450 Drug-Drug Interaction Policies

interaction_rules.explanation: Strong CYP3A4 inhibition prevents clearance of colchicine/statins, causing fatal toxicity or severe rhabdomyolysis.
interaction_rules.remediation: Withhold substrate or select non-CYP3A4 metabolized alternative.

interaction_rules.explanation: CYP2C9 inhibition decreases S-warfarin clearance, leading to supratherapeutic INR and severe hemorrhage risk.
interaction_rules.remediation: Empirically reduce warfarin dose by 50% with daily INR monitoring, or select alternative anticoagulant.

interaction_rules.explanation: Potent CYP3A4 induction significantly lowers target drug serum concentrations, risking treatment failure or breakthrough seizures.
interaction_rules.remediation: Adjust target drug dosing or choose alternative therapeutic regimen.
